content.title: Campuses and Locations
content.text: Miami University's Campuses and Locations Explore Miami University's renowned locations, from our Regional Campuses in Hamilton and Middletown, Ohio, to our original red brick campus in Oxford. Yahoo ranked Oxford as the nation's 3rd-best college town. Poet Robert Frost called it "the most beautiful campus that ever there was." Take a virtual tour, plan a visit, and get to know the communities around your future campus. Miami University in Oxford, OH The Oxford campus is a historic red-brick, classic college setting in Ohio’s rolling hills. For over 200 years, students have come here to study, connect, and grow. You’ll enjoy Oxford’s charm and outdoor beauty while being close (within 5 hours) to six major cities. You’ll find career connections, Fortune 500 internships, and first-rate entertainment nearby. Our Regional Campuses You’ll find our Regional Campuses in Hamilton and Middletown, as well as our VOA learning center in West Chester. Each offers small class sizes, personal attention, and strong preparation for your career. The Dolibois European Center in Luxembourg (MUDEC) At Miami’s Luxembourg campus, all of Europe becomes your classroom. Every semester, more than 100 students learn and travel amid Europe’s art, culture, and history. Stay with a host family or live with classmates and make memories that last a lifetime. Miami Online Earn a Miami University degree or credential your way. You’ll get the same high-quality education as our on-campus students, taught by the same expert faculty. Our 100% online and hybrid programs are available to undergraduate, graduate, and non-degree-seeking students. Prepare to advance your career on your schedule.
